EPISODE_NARRATIVE: A display of the aurora borealis was seen.  This far south, the display seemed to favor a reddish color.  Previously during the autumn, 2 weaker displays were reported late on October 21st and early on October 28th.  However, many citizens that saw the strange colors in the sky on these 3 occasions, did not recognize the display as being the aurora.
